# Town of Pownal municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 18; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the Elected Officials table lists Moderator Tim Holbrook with a term expiring 2026, and the 2026 Warning (Article 4) stood a one-year moderator seat. No official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so the post is created without a membership

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Pownal's five selectboard members: Jeanie Alexander, Michael Gardner, Harry (Jamie) Percey, Karl Strohmaier, and Julie Weber

Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the Elected Officials table lists Karl Strohmaier (term to 2027), Mike Gardner (2026), Bryan Haris (2026), Jeannie Alexander (2026), and Harry 'Jamie' Percy (2028); the 2026 Warning stood two one-year seats and one three-year seat. Read against the June 2026 directory, Gardner took the three-year seat, Alexander was re-elected, Bryan Harris departed, and Town Clerk Julie Weber took the second one-year seat while remaining Town Clerk. The directory's name forms govern over the report's looser spellings
Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the Elected Officials table lists Town Clerk Julie Weber with a three-year term expiring 2027; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Julie Weber as Pownal's Town Clerk
Town of Pownal, Town Contacts page (townofpownal.org): lists Julie Weber as Town Clerk, 'term expires in 2027'
Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the Elected Officials table lists Treasurer Ellen Strohmaier with a three-year term expiring 2027; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Ellen Strohmaier as Pownal's Town Treasurer

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Pownal Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the Elected Officials table lists Delinquent Tax Collector Ellen Strohmaier with a three-year term expiring 2026, and the 2026 Warning (Article 4) stood the office for a three-year term

Town of Pownal, Town Contacts page (townofpownal.org): the town's current page lists Ellen Strohmaier as 'Treasurer/Del Tax Collector'. Her term expired in 2026 and the town presents her as the sitting collector; she is recorded as re-elected on this incumbent-continuity reading, disclosed on issue #163

Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the Elected Officials table lists Constable Eddie Pascucci with a term expiring 2027, and the report's March 2025 local election results record his election as Constable with 38 votes. The office did not stand in 2026 (the results print the term as three years and the table as two; the inconsistency is the town's and is immaterial to the holding

offices.title: Trustee of Public Funds
offices.org_name: Town of Pownal Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): the 2026 Warning (Article 4) elects two Trustees of Public Monies to one-year positions, and the report's March 2025 results show the office filled by an unnamed write-in (35 votes). No holder's name is published in any official source, so both seats are created without memberships

Town of Pownal, 2025 Town Report (townofpownal.org): at the 2025 town meeting the voters approved Article 5 (293-128), placing the town's public burial grounds under a cemetery commission of three commissioners under 18 V.S.A. section 5373; the 2026 Warning (Article 4) stood the commission's initial staggered seats (three-year, two-year, and one-year terms). No holder's name is published in any official source, so all three seats are created without memberships

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Town of Pownal Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Pownal justices of the peace: Alonzo Bisson, Cindy Brownell, Bryan Harris, Harry Percey Sr., Megan Randall, Olden Dwyer, Nelson Brownell, Leslie Morgenthal, Harry (Jamie) Percey Jr, James (Jim) Winchester, David Low, and Zachary (Zach) Rose. The listing itself distinguishes Harry Percey Sr. (a justice only) from Harry (Jamie) Percey Jr (a justice and the selectboard member) -- two people. Bryan Harris remains a justice although he has left the Selectboard
